root_method: bounded least-squares on two components of the actual two-band Hamiltonian in an anchor-aligned eigenframe; new eigenframe at every evaluation
matching: global minimum Euclidean assignment within each gap, thresholded; keep births/losses and ambiguous assignments. No periodic seam stitching or global zero-count claim.

crossing_refinement.target: same local upper branch and two flat nodes; require residuals, 0<t<1, opposite signed offsets at retained bracket ends

stop: Stop a cutoff on computation/flat-root failure; retain all records. Rejected adjacent candidates, inventory disagreement, ambiguous continuation, and missing roots are retained as coverage warnings, not discarded or interpreted as annihilation. Complete the declared bounded inventory despite such warnings.
claims_limit: Finite-seed inventories and sampled continuation only. Grid agreement does not prove completeness; matching does not prove continuous branch identity between stations. No fold/annihilation proof, full braid acceptance, global Euler removal, or physical calibration.
